items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27
items.q: He couldn't play, but he sure did like jazz. He used to follow us around.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Well that's his son, yeah, that's Rudy's son. Yeah. They call him Henny too, Henny Brunis too. Joe Moray. He sure

did love his jazz, that fella, that Brunis. He couldn't play, but he sure did like jazz. He used to follow us around. He used to come to the, when we played at the St. Charles Hotel, he used to come over there all the time half drunk.
Yeah, he come here every time they came here. Every time George would come in town, he came with them, you know, and all. And that's when they give Popper the record. You remember that, Johnny.
